parameters.query:
SELECT 
  PLICRI1_0,
  PRI_0,
  {{ $json.prix_unitaire }} as tarif_devis,
  PLIENDDAT_0,
  '{{ $json.rfq_number }}' as number_rfq,
  '{{ $json.uuid }}' as uuid,
  '{{ $json.designation_article }}' as designation_article,
  
  CASE 
    WHEN PRI_0 > {{ $json.prix_unitaire }} THEN 'tarif systeme superieur'
    WHEN PRI_0 < {{ $json.prix_unitaire }} THEN 'tarif devis superieur'
    ELSE 'tarif identique'
  END AS status_tarif,
  CASE 
    WHEN PLIENDDAT_0 >= '{{ $now.toFormat("yyyy-MM-dd") }}' THEN 'Date fin valide'
    ELSE 'Date fin n est pas valide'
  END AS status_date_article
FROM BASE1.PPRICLIST
WHERE PLICRI1_0 = '{{ $json.code_article }}'

select BPS.BPANUM_0,BPS.WEB_0,BP.BPRNAM_0, '{{ $json.id }}' as cotation_id_ligne,'{{ $json.code_article }}' as code_article from BASE1.BPADDRESS BPS
  inner join BASE1.BPARTNER BP ON BP.BPRNUM_0=BPS.BPANUM_0
where BPS.BPANUM_0='{{ $json.code_fournisseur }}'

select d.code_fournisseur,l.id,l.code_article from demandes_cotation d
  inner join lignes_cotation l on l.rfq_uuid=d.uuid
where numero_rfq='{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.rfq_number }}' and l.code_article='{{ $json.PLICRI1_0 }}'
